meaning: n. 全部曲目；全部技能
example: Young songbirds gradually expand their repertoire by copying older birds. (年輕的鳴禽模仿年長的鳥，逐漸擴充自己的鳴唱曲目。)
The military regime banned newspapers that criticized the government. (軍事政權查禁了批評政府的報紙。)

meaning:
adj. 相反的；對立的
n. 相反；反面
example: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind and many species see quite well. (與一般看法相反，蝙蝠並不是瞎的，許多種類的視力還相當好。)
Doctors sometimes use medicine to induce sleep in patients with severe pain. (醫師有時會用藥物讓劇痛的病人入睡。)
Avian species like crows demonstrate high cognitive capacities, such as tool fabrication and problem-solving. (像烏鴉這樣的鳥類展現出極高的認知能力，例如工具製造和解決問題。)
Researchers found a strong correlation between hours of sunlight and mood in winter. (研究者發現冬季日照時數與情緒之間有很強的相關性。)

meaning: adj. 著名的；重要的；突出的
example: She became a prominent scientist known for her work on ocean currents. (她成為以洋流研究聞名的傑出科學家。)
The academic anthropologist drafted an extensive written discourse evaluating social stratification criteria inside early chiefdom confederacies. (這位人類學家撰寫了一篇詳盡論述，評估早期酋邦聯盟的社會階層標準。)

meaning:
vt. 開發；利用；剝削
n. 功績；英勇事蹟
example: Some bacteria exploit weaknesses in the immune system to spread through the body. (有些細菌利用免疫系統的弱點在體內擴散。)
The letters show a long correspondence between the two scientists about evolution. (這些信件顯示兩位科學家長期就演化問題通信。)
The plan to build a dam caused controversy among farmers and environmental groups. (興建水壩的計畫在農民和環保團體之間引發爭議。)

meaning: adj. 明顯的；顯而易見的
example: The effects of the drought were evident in the dry riverbeds and empty fields. (乾旱的影響從乾涸的河床和荒廢的田地就能明顯看出。)

meaning:
n. 痛苦；憂慮
vt. 使痛苦；使憂慮
example: The sudden decline in company performance caused significant distress among the staff, leading to low morale. (公司績效突然下滑，令員工深感憂慮，也造成士氣低落。)

meaning:
adj. 嚴重的；重大的；莊嚴的
n. 墳墓；墓穴；死亡
example: The audit uncovered a grave accounting error that overstated the company's quarterly earnings. (稽核發現一項嚴重會計錯誤，導致公司季度獲利被高估。)

meaning: v. 迫使；強制；使不得不
example: New rules compel companies to publish their annual emissions, though smaller firms complain about the rising administrative burden. (新規定強制企業公布年度排放量，不過較小的公司抱怨行政負擔日益加重。)

meaning: n. 定罪；信念；堅定看法
example: His conviction for fraud ended his political career, although he still protests that the trial was clearly unfair. (他因詐欺被定罪，政治生涯也因此終結，儘管他仍抗議審判明顯不公平。)
A coalition of trade groups asked the ministry to reconsider the proposed import regulations. (多個貿易團體組成的聯盟要求部會重新考慮進口規範草案。)
Ancient philosophers considered patience an important virtue for leaders. (古代哲學家認為耐心是領導者的重要美德。)
On the map, red dots denote sites where ancient tools were found. (地圖上的紅點代表發現古代工具的地點。)

meaning: adj. 脆弱的；易受傷害的；易受影響的
example: Elderly residents are especially vulnerable during heatwaves, so the council opens several cooled public rooms until well after midnight. (年長居民在熱浪期間特別脆弱，因此市公所開放幾間有冷氣的公共室到午夜過後。)
Engineers reinforced the old bridge with steel beams. (工程師用鋼樑補強了這座舊橋。)
There is broad scientific consensus that human activity is warming the planet. (科學界普遍有共識，認為人類活動正在使地球暖化。)

meaning:
v. 促進；培養；養育
adj. 寄養的；代養的
example: The programme aims to foster closer cooperation between farmers and local schools. (這項計畫旨在促進農民與地方學校之間更緊密的合作。)
The proposition that all swans are white was proved false by black swans in Australia. (「所有天鵝都是白色」這個命題，被澳洲的黑天鵝推翻了。)
The firm denied the allegation that managers had concealed safety defects from regulators during the product review. (該公司否認主管在產品審查期間向監管機關隱瞞安全缺陷的指控。)
The exam tests competence in reading academic texts rather than knowledge of grammar rules. (這項考試測的是閱讀學術文章的能力，而不是文法規則的知識。)
The small shop quietly ceased trading in March, and the old building has remained completely empty ever since. (這家小店三月悄悄停止營業，那棟老建築從此完全空置。)

meaning: v. 盛行；普遍存在；獲勝；占上風
example: This old belief still prevails in the villages far from the coast. (這個古老的觀念在遠離海岸的村落仍然盛行。)
In many cultures, it is the norm for several generations to live in one house. (在許多文化中，幾代同堂是常態。)
Laws against discrimination in hiring were passed in many countries during the 1960s. (許多國家在一九六○年代通過了禁止就業歧視的法律。)
The author asserts that industrial growth depended on cheap energy from coal. (作者主張工業成長仰賴來自煤炭的廉價能源。)
The sudden onset of the Younger Dryas stadial cooling event triggered massive demographic migrations. (新仙女木冷期突然開始，引發大規模的人口遷徙。)
The committee may deem incomplete applications ineligible for review after the posted deadline. (委員會可能認定截止日期後仍未補齊的申請不符合審查資格。)
The instructions were explicit: no phones may be used during the laboratory test. (指示說得很明確：實驗考試期間不得使用手機。)

meaning: adj. 實證的；以經驗為依據的
example: The theory sounds convincing, but there is little empirical evidence to support it. (這個理論聽起來很有說服力，但缺乏實證證據支持。)

meaning:
n. 優點；價值
vt. 值得；應得
example: The board discussed the merits of the new proposal before voting on its implementation. (董事會在投票決定實施新提案前，討論了該提案的優點。)

meaning: vt. 削弱；損害；暗中破壞
example: Frequent changes to the rules can undermine public trust in the government. (規則頻繁更動可能削弱大眾對政府的信任。)
Inspectors condemned the storage building after discovering structural damage that could endanger workers and stored inventory. (檢查人員發現可能危及員工與庫存的結構損壞後，判定倉庫建築不宜使用。)
Many cultures value the wisdom of elders who have lived through hard times. (許多文化重視經歷過艱困時期的長者的智慧。)

meaning: adj. 理性的；合理的；有理數的
example: Economists once assumed that people always make rational choices about money. (經濟學家曾經假設人在金錢上總是做出理性選擇。)

meaning: n. 倫理；倫理學；道德規範
example: The philosophy department offers a course on the ethics of artificial intelligence. (哲學系開設一門關於人工智慧倫理的課程。)

meaning:
n. 研習會；靜修；撤退
vi. 撤退；退縮
example: The leadership team held a retreat to plan the company's long-term goals. (領導團隊舉辦研習活動，規劃公司的長期目標。)

meaning: adv. 一貫地；持續穩定地
example: The supplier consistently met delivery deadlines throughout the year despite seasonal demand changes. (儘管季節性需求變動，供應商全年一貫準時交貨。)

meaning: v. 支持；背書；代言；在背面簽名
example: The retired tennis star agreed to endorse the campaign for cheaper youth sport, provided the funding remained transparent. (這位退休網球明星同意支持降低青年運動費用的活動，條件是經費運用保持透明。)

meaning: n. 貪汙；腐敗；（資料）損毀
example: Widespread corruption slowed economic growth and weakened trust in the courts. (普遍的貪腐拖慢經濟成長，也削弱人們對法院的信任。)
Curiosity is a trait shared by many successful scientists. (好奇心是許多成功科學家共有的特質。)

meaning: adj. 合法的；正當的；合理的
example: Researchers must have a legitimate reason for accessing students' personal records. (研究者必須有正當理由才能查閱學生的個人資料。)
Several residents raised objections to the plan to build a highway through the park. (好幾位居民對穿越公園興建公路的計畫提出異議。)
In the study, higher income correlated with better access to health care. (在這項研究中，收入較高與較容易取得醫療照護相關。)

meaning:
n. 逮捕令；搜查令；正當理由
v. 使有必要；保證；證明合理
example: The damage is serious enough to warrant a full inspection of the roof. (損壞程度嚴重到足以構成全面檢查屋頂的理由。)

meaning: adj. 細微的；微妙的；巧妙的
example: There are subtle differences in the songs of birds from different valleys. (不同山谷的鳥叫聲之間有細微的差異。)

meaning: v. 減少；減弱；降低重要性
example: Battery capacity diminishes quickly in freezing weather, so electric car owners plan shorter winter journeys with extra care. (電池容量在嚴寒天氣中迅速衰減，因此電動車主會更謹慎地規劃較短的冬季行程。)
Late submissions may incur an additional processing fee under the terms of the contract. (依合約條款，逾期提交可能會產生額外處理費。)

meaning:
n. 補救辦法；療法；藥物
v. 補救；矯正；治療
example: There is no easy remedy for the severe shortage of affordable housing. (平價住宅嚴重短缺，沒有簡單的補救辦法。)

meaning: adj. 不情願的；勉強的；遲疑的
example: The witness was reluctant to speak, but a quiet private interview eventually revealed what she had clearly seen. (證人不願開口，但一次安靜的私下訪談最後揭露了她清楚看到的事。)

meaning: n. 意識形態；思想體系
example: The party's ideology emphasized national independence and state control of industry. (該黨的意識形態強調國家獨立與國家掌控產業。)
The conceptual model helps students see how water moves between oceans, clouds and rivers. (這個概念模型幫助學生理解水如何在海洋、雲和河流之間移動。)
The ancient Greek conception of the universe placed the earth at the center. (古希臘人的宇宙觀把地球放在中心。)
The compliance director emphasized that data integrity must be protected throughout every stage of the audit process. (法遵主管強調，稽核流程的每個階段都必須維護資料完整性。)
The essence of the scientific method is testing ideas against careful observation. (科學方法的本質，是用仔細的觀察來檢驗想法。)
The government changed its stance on nuclear power after the accident. (事故發生後，政府改變了對核能的立場。)
The sudden decision to close the factory provoked widespread anger among local workers. (突然決定關閉工廠，引發當地工人的普遍憤怒。)

meaning:
adj. 不知名的；晦澀的；模糊的
vt. 遮掩；使模糊
example: The poem includes obscure references that only experts in Greek history understand. (這首詩包含只有希臘史專家才懂的晦澀典故。)
They decided to defer the final decision until the full report was ready. (他們決定延後做出最後決定，等完整報告出爐再說。)
The drug was withdrawn after several patients suffered adverse reactions. (好幾位病人出現不良反應後，這種藥就被撤回了。)
The teacher devised a simple classroom game to help shy pupils practise speaking without feeling embarrassed. (老師設計了一個簡單的課堂遊戲，幫助害羞的學生練習說話而不覺得尷尬。)
The emergence of large cities created new problems with waste and disease. (大城市的興起帶來了廢棄物與疾病的新問題。)

meaning: vi. 介入；干預；介於其間
example: The government intervened to stop the price of rice from rising further. (政府介入以阻止米價繼續上漲。)
Ice core data provides an indirect record of historical atmospheric composition through trapped air bubbles. (冰芯資料透過封存在冰層中的氣泡，間接呈現歷史大氣的組成。)
The region gained greater autonomy, including control over its own schools and taxes. (這個地區獲得更大的自治權，包括掌管自己的學校和稅收。)

meaning: adj. 深遠的；深刻的；深奧的
example: The invention of the printing press had a profound effect on education. (印刷機的發明對教育產生了深遠的影響。)
Darwin first conceived his theory of natural selection after studying finches and tortoises. (達爾文在研究雀鳥與陸龜之後，首次構想出天擇理論。)

meaning: adj. 倫理的；合乎道德的
example: The committee reviews every study to make sure it follows ethical rules for human subjects. (委員會審查每項研究，確保其遵守人體研究的倫理規範。)

meaning: adj. 不足的；不適當的；不夠好的
example: The new staff received clearly inadequate safety training, so mistakes increased sharply during the busiest weeks of summer. (新員工接受的安全訓練明顯不足，因此在夏季最忙的幾週錯誤急遽增加。)

meaning:
n. 偏見；成見；損害
vt. 使有偏見；損害
example: The study found that prejudice against older workers affected hiring decisions. (研究發現對年長勞工的偏見影響了聘用決策。)
There was much speculation about why the old factory closed so suddenly. (關於那家老工廠為何突然關閉，外界有很多推測。)
Wolves live in packs with a clear hierarchy led by a dominant pair. (狼以群體生活，有由一對強勢個體領導的明確階層。)

meaning:
v. 清楚表達；明確說明
adj. 口齒清晰的；善於表達的
example: A good essay articulates its main argument clearly in the first paragraph. (好的文章會在第一段清楚表達主要論點。)

meaning:
adj. 親密的；私密的；熟悉的
n. 密友；知己
v. 暗示；間接表示
example: Only a few intimate friends were invited to the small wedding ceremony. (婚禮辦得很小，只邀請了幾位親密的朋友。)

meaning: adj. 敵意的；不友善的；不利的
example: The angry meeting turned hostile when residents suddenly learned that the factory would not fund the local cleanup. (居民突然得知工廠不願出資清理當地環境時，原本憤怒的會議氣氛變得充滿敵意。)

meaning: adj. 過度的；過量的；極端的
example: Excessive use of chemical pesticides has damaged the soil and nearby streams. (過度使用化學農藥已損害土壤和附近的溪流。)

meaning: v. 壓制；鎮壓；抑制；隱瞞
example: He struggled to suppress a smile throughout the serious official announcement. (在嚴肅的官方公告期間，他努力忍住笑意。)

meaning:
adj. 值得注意的；顯著的；著名的
n. 名人；知名人士
example: There is one notable exception to the rule, which the manual mentions only briefly. (這項規則有一個值得注意的例外，手冊只簡短提到它。)

meaning: vt. 操縱；操控；（巧妙地）處理
example: Researchers manipulated the amount of light each plant received to test its effect on growth. (研究者調整每株植物接受的光量，以檢驗光對生長的影響。)

meaning: n. 有效性；合法性；效度
example: Critics questioned the validity of the survey because only fifty people took part. (批評者質疑這份調查的效度，因為只有五十人參與。)

meaning:
n. 刻板印象
vt. 對……有成見
example: The study challenges the stereotype that older workers cannot learn new technology. (這項研究挑戰了「年長勞工學不會新科技」的刻板印象。)
Scientists once presumed that no life could survive near deep-sea volcanoes. (科學家曾經認為深海火山附近不可能有生命存活。)

meaning: n. 修辭；言辭；花言巧語
example: Voters grew tired of political rhetoric and wanted clear plans instead. (選民厭倦了政治辭令，想要的是明確的計畫。)

meaning: v. 承認；讓步；認輸；（比賽中）失分
example: He finally conceded that the original plan had been far too ambitious. (他終於承認，原先的計畫實在太過雄心勃勃。)

meaning: adj. 意識形態的；思想體系的
example: Ideological differences among board members delayed approval of the company's international expansion plan. (董事會成員之間的意識形態差異，延後了公司國際擴張計畫的核准。)
The author offers little justification for her claim that the policy failed. (作者對「這項政策失敗了」的說法提不出什麼正當理由。)
Doctors face a dilemma when a treatment could help a patient but also cause serious side effects. (當一種療法可能幫助病人卻也可能造成嚴重副作用時，醫師就陷入兩難。)
A neutral country agreed to mediate between the two sides of the conflict. (一個中立國同意在衝突雙方之間進行調解。)
The main flaw in the argument is that it ignores rising costs. (這項論點的主要缺陷，是忽略了成本上漲。)
The confirmation of tectonic plate displacement created a massive scientific paradigm shift within geology. (地殼板塊位移的證實，在地質學內部創造了一次巨大的科學範式轉移。)

meaning: n. 相關性；關聯；切題性
example: Students often question the relevance of basic algebra, yet it quietly underpins many important everyday decisions about money. (學生常質疑基礎代數有何相關性，但它其實支撐著許多重要的日常金錢決策。)

meaning: n. 學說；教義；政策原則
example: The doctrine of free trade has shaped national economic policy for decades. (自由貿易學說數十年來一直形塑著國家的經濟政策。)
The human resources department treats all employees with respect and dignity. (人力資源部門以尊重和尊嚴對待所有員工。)
The accumulation of surplus agricultural wealth inside early chiefdoms triggered institutional social inequality. (早期酋邦累積的農業剩餘財富，引發了制度性的社會不平等。)

meaning:
v. 說出；發出；吐露
adj. 完全的；十足的；徹底的
example: She did not utter a word. (她一句話也沒說。)
The study lost credibility when other labs could not repeat its results. (其他實驗室無法重現結果後，這項研究就失去了可信度。)

meaning:
adj. 美學的；審美的
n. 美學；美感
example: The architect balanced practical needs with aesthetic choices, such as large windows facing the river. (建築師在實用需求與美學選擇之間取得平衡，例如面向河流的大窗戶。)

meaning: v. 仔細考慮；沉思；凝視
example: He sat on the balcony to contemplate whether to accept the job offer. (他坐在陽台上，仔細考慮是否接受這份工作邀約。)

meaning:
adj. 高尚的；貴族的；（氣體）惰性的
n. 貴族
example: Noble families controlled most of the land in medieval Europe. (中世紀歐洲大部分的土地由貴族家族控制。)

meaning: n. 讓步；特許權；優惠；（售貨）攤位
example: Both sides eventually made painful concessions before signing the final trade agreement. (雙方最終在簽署最終貿易協定前，做出了艱難的讓步。)
The engineering team will endeavor to resolve the technical issue by tonight. (工程團隊將努力在今晚之前解決技術問題。)

meaning: adj. 模糊的；不清楚的；含糊的
example: The instructions were too vague, so many students misunderstood the assignment. (說明太含糊，所以很多學生誤解了作業內容。)
The new director is building on the successful foundation laid by his predecessor. (新總監正建立在前任所打下的成功基礎上。)
My conscience told me to tell the truth. (我的良心告訴我要說實話。)

meaning: adj. 原始的；粗糙的；粗俗的
example: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel for cars. (原油必須經過提煉，才能當作汽車燃料使用。)

meaning: adj. 句法的；語法結構的
example: The sentence has a syntactic error. (這個句子有句法錯誤。)

meaning: v. 主張；爭辯；競爭；奮力對付
example: Critics contend that the new law will seriously harm many already struggling small local businesses. (批評者主張，這項新法會嚴重傷害許多已陷困境的當地小型企業。)

meaning: v. 制定；構想；用公式表示；清楚表達
example: The committee spent six months formulating a clear policy on short-term rentals. (委員會花了六個月制定一套明確的短期租屋政策。)
Time travel remains in the realm of science fiction. (時光旅行仍屬於科幻小說的範疇。)

meaning:
adj. 明顯的；顯而易見的
v. 顯示；表明；顯現

meaning: adj. 平庸的；普通的；不出色的
example: The board was dissatisfied with the mediocre performance of the marketing campaign. (董事會對行銷活動的平庸表現感到不滿。)
The committee treated the claim as a complete fabrication because no written document supported the witness's detailed account. (委員會認為這項說法完全是捏造，因為沒有書面文件支持證人的詳細陳述。)
She is adept at resolving customer complaints efficiently and professionally. (她擅長有效率、專業地解決客訴。)
The people suffered under tyranny. (人民在暴政下受苦。)

meaning: adj. 難以理解的；費解的
example: Without a legend, the map's symbols were incomprehensible to residents unfamiliar with the new transit network. (沒有圖例時，不熟悉新大眾運輸網路的居民無法理解地圖符號。)

meaning: v. 理想化；將……想得過於完美
example: It is dangerous to idealize market trends without analyzing the actual data. (在不分析實際資料的情況下將市場趨勢理想化是危險的。)
Quiet study spaces are conducive to concentration, especially for students sharing crowded accommodation. (安靜的自習空間有助於專注，尤其適合住在擁擠住所的學生。)
A widening rift between neighboring countries complicated negotiations over shared river resources. (鄰國之間日益擴大的嫌隙，使共同河川資源的談判更加複雜。)
The desolate mining town slowly recovered after a university opened a research center in the abandoned factory. (大學在廢棄工廠設立研究中心後，荒涼的礦業城鎮逐漸復甦。)
The marketing director watched the initial consumer enthusiasm dissipate after a week. (行銷總監看到最初的消費者熱情在一週後消散。)

meaning: n. 個人主義；個人自主
example: The essay contrasts individualism with community traditions that emphasize shared responsibility and collective decision-making. (這篇文章對比個人主義與強調共同責任、集體決策的社群傳統。)
In emergency procurement, public safety should take precedence over speed or political convenience. (緊急採購時，公共安全應優先於速度或政治方便。)

meaning: n. 強迫；難以抗拒的衝動
example: The law creates no compulsion to sell, but it gives owners a tax incentive to participate. (法律沒有強迫出售，但提供稅務誘因鼓勵屋主參與。)
The report uses regional comparisons to accentuate disparities hidden by the national average. (報告運用區域比較，凸顯被全國平均掩蓋的差距。)

meaning: adj. 一絲不苟的；非常仔細的
example: The accountant is meticulous when reviewing the company's financial records. (會計師在審查公司的財務記錄時非常細緻。)
The specter of default unsettled bondholders even after the company secured short-term financing. (即使公司取得短期融資，違約陰影仍令債券持有人不安。)
The board of directors gave their unanimous assent to proceed with the highly lucrative acquisition. (董事會一致同意推動這項利潤豐厚的收購案。)

meaning: adj. 休眠的；暫停活動的
example: The dormant volcano showed no recent activity, although scientists continued monitoring gas emissions and ground movement. (這座休眠火山近期沒有活動，但科學家仍持續監測氣體排放與地表移動。)
The agency will promulgate revised standards after public hearings conclude later this summer. (公聽會預計今年夏末結束，之後主管機關將頒布修訂後的標準。)
Tree planting can counteract some urban heat by shading streets and increasing moisture released through leaves. (植樹可透過街道遮蔭與葉片蒸散增加濕度，抵銷部分都市熱效應。)
Local engineers showed great ingenuity in rebuilding the bridge with limited materials. (當地工程師在材料有限的情況下重建橋樑，展現了極大的獨創性。)
The critic called the landscape sublime, but noted how mining had scarred nearby hills. (評論家稱景色壯麗，也指出採礦如何破壞附近山丘。)

meaning: adj. 永恆的；歷久彌新的
example: This song has timeless beauty. (這首歌有永恆的美。)
The conference room served as a makeshift office during the building’s renovation. (大樓整修期間，會議室暫時充當辦公室。)

meaning:
n. 猛獁象；龐然大物
adj. 巨大的；龐大的
example: The mammoth excavation required hundreds of specialists to document artifacts before construction could resume. (這項龐大的挖掘工程需要數百名專家記錄文物，工程才能恢復。)
The new chair tried to infuse the agency with transparency, publishing meeting records and contract awards. (新任主席試圖為機構注入透明度，公布會議紀錄和合約決標資訊。)

meaning: adj. 古怪有趣的；獨特的
example: The firm's quirky advertising attracted attention, yet sales rose only after prices became competitive. (公司古怪有趣的廣告吸引目光，但直到價格具競爭力後銷售才上升。)
The fossil preserved evidence of primordial organisms that lived before complex animals evolved. (這塊化石保存了複雜動物演化前原始生物的證據。)
The young racehorse has an impressive pedigree and attracted several wealthy buyers. (這匹年輕賽馬血統優良，吸引了幾位富有買家。)

meaning: adj. 難以區分的；無法辨別的
example: Without reliable labels, the counterfeit medicine was nearly indistinguishable from approved products on the shelf. (沒有可靠標籤時，仿冒藥品幾乎無法和架上的核准產品區分。)

meaning: adj. 存在的；攸關生存的
example: The report frames climate risk as an existential threat to island communities and their economies. (報告將氣候風險描述為威脅島嶼社群及其經濟生存的重大危機。)

meaning: v. 佔主導地位；佔多數；盛行
example: Small retail stores continue to predominate in the local business landscape. (小型零售店繼續在當地商業格局中佔據主導地位。)

meaning: n. 矛盾心理；好惡交雜
example: Voters' ambivalence toward the reform reflected both concern about costs and distrust of officials. (選民對改革好惡交雜，既擔心成本，也不信任官員。)
The dishonest contractor attempted to fabricate receipts to claim extra expenses. (不誠實的承包商試圖偽造收據來索取額外費用。)
An ardent supporter of public libraries organized neighborhood events to protect funding for children's reading programs. (一名熱心的公共圖書館支持者舉辦社區活動，保護兒童閱讀計畫的經費。)
A resurgence of investment followed the court ruling, which clarified property rights for developers. (法院裁決釐清開發商的財產權後，投資再度回升。)
The cable remained taut under the platform, preventing the scientific instruments from drifting in strong currents. (平台下方的纜線保持緊繃，避免科學儀器被強勁水流沖走。)

meaning:
n. 不信任；猜疑
v. 不信任；猜疑
example: Mistrust between residents and officials slowed recovery after the industrial accident contaminated local drinking water. (工業事故污染當地飲用水後，居民與官員之間的不信任拖慢了復原。)
The advertisement used a seductive image. (廣告使用了誘人的圖片。)
The source requested anonymity because the documents had not yet been cleared for public release. (消息來源要求匿名，因為文件尚未獲准公開。)
The marketing campaign was praised by the board for its exceptional originality. (此次行銷活動因其非凡的創意而受到董事會的讚揚。)
One diagram encapsulated the entire argument by showing how rainfall, soil, and vegetation interact across seasons. (一張圖概括了整個論點，呈現降雨、土壤與植被如何隨季節交互作用。)
The legal department collected sufficient evidence to substantiate the patent claim. (法律部門收集了足夠的證據來證實該專利主張。)
Her insightful comments helped the committee recognize assumptions that had shaped decades of environmental planning. (她有見地的評論協助委員會辨認數十年來影響環境規劃的假設。)
The report galvanized public support by documenting how pollution affected children living near the industrial zone. (報告記錄工業區附近兒童受污染影響的情況，激起大眾支持。)
Economic and environmental concerns intertwine when communities depend on fishing for both income and cultural identity. (社區仰賴漁業維生並維繫文化認同時，經濟與環境議題便交織在一起。)
The downfall of the corporation was largely attributed to poor strategic planning and over-leveraged debt. (該公司垮台主要歸因於策略規畫不佳和過度槓桿的債務。)

meaning: adj. 令人陶醉的；令人振奮的
example: The heady rise in share prices encouraged investors to overlook mounting losses in core operations. (股價令人振奮地上漲，讓投資人忽視核心業務不斷增加的虧損。)
Unease among employees grew when management announced restructuring without explaining its selection criteria. (管理階層宣布重整卻不說明評選標準，員工的不安因此加深。)

meaning: adj. 認真負責的；盡責的；謹慎的
example: She is conscientious about her work. (她對工作很認真負責。)
The advertisement used a clever ploy to attract attention without making unsupported claims about the product. (這則廣告使用巧妙手段吸引注意，沒有對產品提出缺乏根據的宣稱。)
If you fail to meet the project deadline, you will forfeit your bonus for this quarter. (如果未能趕上專案期限，您將失去本季獎金。)
The report was based on erroneous data collected during the previous winter. (這份報告根據的是前一年冬天蒐集的錯誤資料。)

meaning: adj. 顛覆性的；破壞性的
example: The novel's subversive themes challenged political authority and encouraged readers to question accepted social hierarchies. (這部小說的顛覆性主題挑戰政治權威，鼓勵讀者質疑既有社會階序。)
The lawsuit alleged misrepresentation after buyers discovered defects omitted from the property disclosures. (買方發現屋況揭露漏掉瑕疵後，提告指控賣方不實陳述。)
Modesty is one of his best qualities. (謙虛是他最好的特質之一。)
At this juncture, the board must choose between a costly merger and a slower internal recovery. (在這個關鍵時點，董事會必須在高成本合併和較慢的內部復甦之間做選擇。)
The union agreed to cede some scheduling authority in exchange for stronger job protections. (工會同意讓出部分排班權，換取更完善的工作保障。)
The court's pronouncement clarified the rule but left its application to local agencies unresolved. (法院的正式宣告釐清了規則，卻沒有解決地方機關如何適用。)
A ferocious debate followed the proposal to redirect water from farms toward expanding cities. (將農業用水轉往擴張中的城市之提案，引發激烈辯論。)
The actual project progress started to deviate from the original plan due to unexpected technical challenges. (由於意料之外的技術挑戰，實際專案進度開始偏離原計畫。)
Her prowess at repairing clocks often surprises visitors. (她修理鐘錶的高超技藝常讓訪客驚訝。)
Limited broadband access remains an impediment to online education in several remote communities. (寬頻網路有限，仍是數個偏遠社區推動線上教育的障礙。)

meaning: n. 轉捩點；分水嶺；流域
example: The confirmation of lithospheric drift mapping tools marked a critical historical watershed inside modern geological paradigms. (岩石圈漂移測繪工具獲得證實，成為現代地質學發展中的重要轉捩點。)

meaning: n. 正統觀念；傳統教義
example: The historian challenged the orthodoxy that economic growth alone explains the city's political transformation. (這位歷史學家質疑了單靠經濟成長就能解釋該市政治轉型的正統觀點。)
A shrill editorial tone weakened the newspaper's otherwise careful argument about public spending. (尖銳刺耳的社論語氣，削弱了報紙原本審慎的公共支出論點。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的
example: An external auditor was hired to provide an impartial review of the accounts. (聘請了一名外部稽核師對帳目進行公正的審查。)
A staunch advocate of open data argued that public research should remain accessible to every citizen. (一名堅定的開放資料倡議者主張，公共研究應讓每位公民都能取得。)

meaning: adj. 引發分歧的；分化的
example: The divisive zoning proposal split neighborhood leaders despite their shared support for affordable housing. (這項引發分歧的分區提案，使原本都支持平價住宅的社區領袖分成兩派。)

meaning: adj. 堅持的；一再要求的
example: The client was insistent that the project deadline should remain unchanged despite the technical issues. (客戶堅持即使有技術問題，專案期限也不應更動。)
Investigators traced the bogus invoices to a supplier that had never delivered the listed equipment. (調查人員追查出，這些假發票來自一家從未交付所列設備的供應商。)
His instinctive reaction to the market shift helped the company avoid potential losses. (他對市場變化的本能反應幫助公司避免了潛在損失。)
His leadership style is exemplary and serves as a blueprint for the junior managers within the department. (他的領導風格堪稱模範，是部門內初階經理人的參考典範。)
Arid regions support fewer plant species unless seasonal rivers provide reliable water for extended periods. (除非季節性河流長期穩定供水，否則乾旱地區能生長的植物種類較少。)
The board rejected the flimsy forecast because it ignored currency risks and rising transport costs. (董事會否決了這份薄弱的預測，因為它忽略匯率風險和上升的運輸成本。)
During its heyday, the observatory attracted scientists from many countries to study newly discovered planets. (天文台在全盛時期吸引許多國家的科學家前來研究新發現的行星。)

meaning: adj. 平等主義的；平等的
example: The egalitarian policy gave all students equal access to laboratory equipment regardless of their academic department. (這項平等政策讓所有學生不分科系，都能平等使用實驗室設備。)

meaning: adj. 雄偉的；莊嚴的；宏偉的
example: The mountain looked majestic at sunrise. (那座山在日出時看起來很壯麗。)
The philosopher argued that virtuous actions require more than good intentions and must consider their consequences. (哲學家主張，有美德的行為不能只有善意，也必須考慮其後果。)

meaning: adj. 平靜的；安詳的；寧靜的
example: The lake was serene in the morning. (早晨的湖很寧靜。)
The river meanders through farmland before reaching the delta, where sediment accumulates along its branches. (河流蜿蜒穿過農田後抵達三角洲，沉積物在各分支沿岸堆積。)
He made an impulsive decision. (他做了一個衝動的決定。)

meaning: adj. 不可思議的；離奇的
example: The model made an uncanny prediction about storm intensity using only historical rainfall and sea temperature data. (這個模型僅使用歷史降雨與海溫資料，就對風暴強度做出不可思議的預測。)
Predatory fish altered the food web after entering the lake through a canal connecting two watersheds. (掠食性魚類經連接兩個集水區的運河進入湖泊後，改變了食物網。)
A brief respite in the fighting allowed aid workers to restore water service across several districts. (戰事短暫停歇，讓救援人員得以恢復數個行政區的供水。)

meaning: adj. 發光的；明亮的；夜光的
example: The watch has luminous hands. (這支錶有夜光指針。)
